title: Match replays
body: Done: replay_recorder.gd records every match (15 Hz, gzip, last 20 kept); REPLAYS screen + replay_player.gd plays them back with pause, speed, seek, follow / free cam.

title: Flaky: client logs Node not found Main/BotRocket_* right after joining
body: Fixed earlier by sending projectile updates through Main.net_proj by name (unknown nodes are dropped quietly); no recurrence in later gate runs.

title: Flaky: weapon test bot Barrett sometimes misses its single shot
body: The bot now has 999 ammo and a 10 s window; passed every run since (re-checked twice for 1.30).

title: Two pickup name tags overlap when kits sit next to each other
body: item_label.gd merges identical neighbours and stacks different ones; new gate test (label_overlap_test.gd) checks Voland and four other maps.

title: Deploy a public master server so relay and listing work out of the box
body: Running on Oracle Cloud (161.153.9.69:8080) with the official game server next to it.

title: Relay server so internet games work without UPnP or port forwarding
body: The master server's /relay has hosted R- codes since 1.23.

title: Leaderboard missed brand-new players
body: Settings.profile_id was only generated inside load_settings(), which returns early without a settings file.

title: Clan tags and friends list
body: Settings.clan_tag / display_name(); servers send player names in the heartbeat; friends_panel.gd.

title: Tracer and jet flame colors
body: customization.gd TRACERS / JET_COLORS with unlocks; unlock pacing to level 25.
